note: EV SIGHTINGS - PAPER STUDY, MEASUREMENT ONLY. Never bets, never pushed. Triggers: A = best after-fee cost >= 2c under the median after-fee cost of the other books at the same line, >= $250 at the best price (qualifying >= 3c); B = best gettable (>= $250) after-fee cost beats Pinnacle no-vig fair at the same line by >= 3% EV; M (Amendment A1, Oct 27) = Pinnacle move-watch: Pinnacle line moves >= 0.5 pts between consecutive polls (primary) or price moves >= 5 cents on an unchanged line (cents scale: -110=110, +100=100, +105=95); the four exchanges are read the same cycle at the OLD number for the side the market moved toward. gettable = a book's after-fee cost <= Pinnacle's pre-move price on that side (threshold_cost, with vig) AND >= $250 resting at that price or better. Every move is logged; not-gettable moves are the control group (graded at the best available price at the old number when any book lists it). detection_lag_s = detection time - Pinnacle's market last_update. move_held_c = Pinnacle close fair at the old number - pre-move fair. One record per A/B trigger/game/market/line/side (first sighting; last_seen/scans_seen while it persists); one record per move. Costs are 0-1 per $1 payout after fees (Kalshi 0.07 and Polymarket US 0.0695 x P x (1-P) taker; ProphetX 2% of winnings; Novig none). depth_usd = $ bettable at that book's best price. ref_age_s = exchange read time - Pinnacle market last_update. Close = last pregame read; close_consensus_fair = median of books' no-vig mids; pin_close_fair = sharp_monitor.close_prob at the sighting's number from the last pregame Pinnacle poll (pin_close_same_line false = half points priced in). clv_*_c = (close fair - sighting_cost_af) x 100. result/units_flat = ESPN final, flat 1u at sighting_cost_af. crossed = that book's two sides cost < 97c total (stale/crossed quote). Pinnacle polls: every 300s per sport while a game starts within 6h, every 1200s otherwise; skipped when the credits left would fall below the sharp monitor's projected need for the rest of the month. A2 maker test: see the maker list (paper resting bids). Oct 28 data-quality rules: suspect = best price 10c+ under the other books' median or a crossed quote (kept, flagged, excluded from headline report rows); clv_pinnacle_c only when the sighting's line is within 3 points of Pinnacle's (pin_close_far).
